note: Only 5 of these 10 progress tokens are randomly selected and made available in any single game; the other 5 are set aside unused for that game. See data/README.md.

effects.note: Reduces the resource cost (player's choice of which resources) of each wonder stage built after acquiring this token by 2. Coin cost is unaffected.

Whenever the opponent pays coins to the bank to trade for resources they lack (to build a card or wonder), you receive those coins instead of the bank. Does not apply to the card/wonder's own coin cost, only extra trading payments.

This token itself counts as a 7th, unique scientific symbol for the purposes of the 6-distinct-symbols scientific supremacy victory and for triggering the 'own 2 identical symbols' progress-token bonus.
Reduces the resource cost (player's choice of which resources) of each civilian (blue) building built after acquiring this token by 2. Coin cost is unaffected.
Counts every progress token the owning player has at game end, including Mathematics itself.
Every military (red) building constructed after acquiring this token grants one additional shield beyond its printed value.
Every wonder stage built after acquiring this token grants an extra turn, as if it had the Play Again effect. Does not stack with a wonder that already grants Play Again.
Every time you construct a building for free via a chain symbol after acquiring this token, gain 4 coins.
